Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses two distinct quantification strategies: SILAC for initial background assessment and LFQ for the deep S-acylproteome profiling. The primary enrichment is for S-acylation (palmitoylation), which maps to a lipid-related proteomics modifier (mod_lip_ms). DTDP and NEM are used as blocking agents on cysteines and are explicitly mentioned as search parameters.

scope: S-acylated proteins are converted into biotinylated proteins, so they can be enriched by streptavidin affinity purification and identified by LC–MS/MS.

The S-acylated proteins were enriched from human LNCaP cells by a low-background acyl-biotinyl exchange method that we developed, digested by three endoproteinases (trypsin, Asp-N, and Arg-C) using filter-aided sample preparation (FASP), and analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
